assumptions: Apex Global Solutions will provide necessary API credentials and network access for SharePoint and SAP integrations.
The 15,000 historical documents provided are representative of future lease and contract types.
Azure consumption costs are managed and paid for directly by Apex Global Solutions.
Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) will be available for 4 hours per week during the Discovery and UAT phases.
summary: The source material is a proposal for an Azure-native AI Contract Intelligence system for Apex Global Solutions. The solution aims to automate extraction from commercial leases and supplier contracts, targeting high accuracy (≥92%) and strict data residency within a private Azure tenant to reduce operational costs and financial risks.
